use_checkpoint_wrapper: wrap a PyTorch nn.Module to enable activation checkpointing for reduced memory usage during training
use_pack_kwargs: pack positional and keyword arguments into a flat list for autograd compatibility
use_unpack_kwargs: unpack a flat argument list back into positional args and a keyword arguments dictionary
use_split_non_tensors: split a mixed tuple of Tensors and non-Tensor objects into separate Tensor and non-Tensor groups
use_CheckpointFunction: use the CheckpointFunction autograd class to perform activation checkpointing with support for non-Tensor outputs
